source_semantics: Individual undergoing identity proofing before establishment as subscriber
relation_or_lifecycle: provides evidence/attributes; participates in resolution-validation-verification

source_semantics: Entity responsible for identity proofing/enrollment, authenticator/credential lifecycle and/or identity services
relation_or_lifecycle: proofs/enrolls applicant; establishes subscriber account; binds authenticators; may operate IdP

source_semantics: Evidence supplied to support claimed real-world identity
relation_or_lifecycle: collected; validated for authenticity/accuracy/validity; verified as referring to applicant

source_semantics: Collects attributes/evidence to distinguish a unique real-life identity within population/context
relation_or_lifecycle: precedes validation; does not by itself complete proofing

source_semantics: Confirms authenticity accuracy validity/currentness of evidence and attribute information
relation_or_lifecycle: operates on Evidence; precedes verification

source_semantics: Confirms applicant presenting valid evidence is individual to whom evidence was issued
relation_or_lifecycle: establishes linkage between validated evidence and live applicant

source_semantics: Composite proofing process establishing applicant identity to stated confidence/IAL
relation_or_lifecycle: includes resolution validation verification; leads to subscriber account/enrollment

source_semantics: After successful proofing CSP establishes/maintains subscriber account and identity service relationship
relation_or_lifecycle: creates subscriber account/record and enables authenticator binding

source_semantics: Account established for subscriber after proofing/enrollment
relation_or_lifecycle: has enrollment record; authenticators bound; lifecycle maintained by CSP

source_semantics: Individual enrolled in CSP identity service and associated with subscriber account
relation_or_lifecycle: owns/controls authenticators; authenticates; federates to RP

source_semantics: Level expressing strength/confidence requirements for identity proofing
relation_or_lifecycle: proofing process/evidence must meet IAL requirements

source_semantics: Means used by claimant to demonstrate control/knowledge/possession for authentication
relation_or_lifecycle: bound to subscriber account; used in authentication; lifecycle managed

source_semantics: Establishment of association between specific authenticator and subscriber account
relation_or_lifecycle: created at enrollment or later; CSP maintains record; may be revoked/replaced

source_semantics: Binding loss theft unauthorized duplication expiration revocation replacement/recovery events affecting authenticator use
relation_or_lifecycle: state/association changes over subscriber lifecycle

source_semantics: Claimant demonstrates control of authenticator(s) to verifier under AAL requirements
relation_or_lifecycle: uses bound authenticator; produces authentication result/establishes session

source_semantics: Strength requirements for authentication and authenticator combinations
relation_or_lifecycle: constrains accepted authenticators/protocol/session behavior

source_semantics: Authenticator whose authentication keys can be copied/synchronized across devices under requirements
relation_or_lifecycle: sync fabric stores encrypted keys; multiple device instances may exercise authentication capability

source_semantics: Bounded interaction state established after authentication to maintain continuity
relation_or_lifecycle: starts after authentication; expires/terminates/re-authentication requirements

source_semantics: Conveys authentication/subscriber attributes across separately administered IdP and RP systems
relation_or_lifecycle: three-party subscriber-IdP-RP relationship; assertion generated/presented

source_semantics: CSP/verifier role in federation that authenticates subscriber and issues assertion to RP
relation_or_lifecycle: authenticates subscriber; creates assertion; transmits allowed attributes

source_semantics: Party receiving/using IdP assertion and deciding local transaction/access
relation_or_lifecycle: requests federation; validates/processes assertion; starts independent local session

source_semantics: Packaged statement from IdP to RP about authenticated subscriber/authentication event and optional attributes
relation_or_lifecycle: issued per federated login; audience/time constrained; consumed to establish RP session

source_semantics: Security requirements for construction/protection/presentation of federation assertions
relation_or_lifecycle: FAL1-3 constrain signature/encryption/holder-of-key properties

source_semantics: RP and IdP maintain sessions independently after federation
relation_or_lifecycle: RP session starts after processing federation; IdP session may pre-exist/terminate separately

source_semantics: Assertion has issuance-to-expiration lifetime and is normally single-login artifact
relation_or_lifecycle: must not be used past expiry; session may expire earlier

source_semantics: Assertion references subscriber-held key and requires proof of possession to RP
relation_or_lifecycle: subscriber proves possession; key may differ from IdP authentication key

source_semantics: Federated relationship alone does not imply permission to transmit information; release may require whitelist/blacklist/runtime authorized decision
relation_or_lifecycle: authorized party may approve/revoke information release

source_semantics: Intermediary in federation chain between upstream IdP and downstream RP
relation_or_lifecycle: receives/reissues/proxies assertions; effective FAL bounded by weakest segment
